manual.reason: The selection Ask panel is experimental and its only browser exercise (tests/selection-ask-live.mjs) drives a locally built jar against synthetic server frames, so it is not a reproducible named test; it is NOT counted as evidence.
manual.steps: Select text in main chat, invoke copy, quote and explain; repeat with a long selection and with no selection.
manual.expected: Exactly the selected text is copied or quoted, the explanation opens in a closable panel, and with no selection the previous whole-message actions are unchanged.

manual.reason: The no-selection path is guarded by the existing whole-message action tests, which are owned by the message-action changes rather than by this change, so no test here is named for it.
manual.steps: Open a message context menu without selecting any text.
manual.expected: The whole-message copy/quote/Ask actions behave exactly as they did before this change.
